focus: Central and South Los Angeles, Hollywood, and nearby neighborhoods, plus one clearly labeled Beverly Hills office
intro: This first Los Angeles page covers official truck-rental locations and labor-only movers whose own public pages list an address in Los Angeles or, in one clearly labeled case, a Beverly Hills office that publishes service across Los Angeles County. It is not a complete citywide inventory, and it does not report live truck counts. One-way and cargo-van flags are on only when the location page mentions those services. If a day’s hours were missing, they are marked “Not published,” not guessed as closed. If you already have a truck or container, use the labor-only filter or the HireAHelper box further down the page.

listings.name: Bloom Movers

hours.notes: Hours from the official labor-only page, which lists Monday–Sunday 7 AM–9 PM and says the company is open seven days a week.

listings.offersNotes: The official labor-only page says Bloom Movers provides a crew when you already have a truck, pod, or container. It specifically mentions loading a U-Haul, Penske, or Budget truck, and loading or unloading PODS, 1-800-PACK-RAT, or U-Pack containers. The same page says same-day moves are available and that the company is locally owned in Los Angeles.
listings.visitNotes: Confirm crew availability for your date. Same-day availability is the company’s published claim, not a guarantee in this directory.

listings.name: Rigos Moving & Storage, Inc.
listings.address: 4385 E. Olympic Blvd., Los Angeles, CA 90023

hours.notes: Office hours from the official homepage, which lists Monday–Saturday 8:00 am–6:00 pm and Sunday closed.

offers: Loading-only for rental trucks and containers
listings.offersNotes: The official homepage includes a loading-only mention for pods, ABF, rental trucks, and similar equipment, alongside broader moving and storage services. This listing flags labor-only because loading-only is published; a full-service move is a different product on the same site.
listings.visitNotes: Sunday is published as closed. Confirm that you are booking loading-only help rather than a full-service move.

listings.name: XL Movers

hours.notes: The official labor-only page lists an address and phone number but does not publish daily hours. Call the company rather than assuming a walk-in window.

listings.offersNotes: The official labor-only page says the service is for customers who already have a truck and need help packing, moving, loading, and unloading. It also says a labor-only booking includes movers and a light-duty vehicle, plus tools, dollies, and pads if needed. Confirm whether you need only labor, or labor plus that light-duty vehicle, when you book.
listings.visitNotes: Daily hours are not published on the labor-only page. The same company also mentions warehouses in DTLA, Torrance, Pasadena, and North Hollywood; this listing uses the Wilshire Boulevard address printed on the labor-only page.

listings.name: Pro Express Moving
listings.address: 1010 Wilshire Blvd, Suite 405, Los Angeles, CA 90017

hours.notes: The official loading-and-unloading page lists Monday–Saturday 8am–6pm in the footer. Sunday hours are not published on that page, so they are marked “Not published” rather than assumed closed.

listings.offersNotes: The official page says labor-only crews load or unload a rental truck, POD, container, or trailer that the customer supplies. Published crew rates on that page are $149/hour for two movers or $209/hour for three, with the one-hour minimum waived on this service and a $99 booking deposit applied to the labor total. Confirm live rates when you book; they can change.
listings.visitNotes: The published address is an office suite. Confirm crew availability for your date and neighborhood.
listings.feeNotes: Rates quoted above are copied from the official loading-and-unloading page last checked November 18, 2026, and may change.
